discussion_comments.comment_body: Leaving the autoscaler alone in this PR. It is off by default and the server cannot run more than one replica (SQLite and an in-memory job queue), which the docs already say. Anyone who turns it on has to set requests, as with any chart whose default is `resources: {}`. Removing the HPA template would be the cleaner fix, but that is a separate change.

discussion_comments.comment_body: Leaving this as it is. A cluster with nodes outside amd64 and arm64 is unusual, and `nodeSelector` and `affinity` are there for it. A default required affinity would be one more thing to undo for anyone running a custom image.
